story.value: Begin at Fortress of the Barren Family. Lift the curse affecting the unworked memorial, on which wounds taken here do not close until it is lifted. Each section has its own holder and marked threshold. The other listed sites are additional jobs in the same region.

traits: Ground Shudder. replaces the attack action; once per fight. Trigger: At least two enemies are close on the same solid ground. Range: close. Make one existing stomp attack (+7, 2d10 damage) against a close target. Whether it hits or misses, all other creatures close to it on the same solid ground make DC 12 DEX or fall prone. No additional damage is dealt. Flying creatures are unaffected by the ground shock. This replaces the normal three stomps. Telegraph: It raises a forefoot high and the ground trembles as its weight shifts. Behaviour: Use when two or more enemies crowd its feet and no herd mate is in the area; attack the nearest enemy, then randomly.

reading.description: A person walks down a path, unwittingly dropping items along the way. The Fool card represents innocence.
reading.meaning: A naive Celestial or a flighty Fey, or a trap with a simple or obvious means of avoiding it.
